title: An end date before the start date is accepted, with negative days
summary: A request whose end date is before its start date is saved instead of refused. Its day count is negative, so if a manager approves it the employee's balance goes up.
steps: Request leave from 15 March 2030 to 13 March 2030 (dates the wrong way round).
No error is shown; the request appears as pending with -1 days.

expected.text: The end date must be on or after the start date; otherwise HTTP 400 with a message, and nothing is saved.

actual: HTTP 201. The request is stored with days = -1 and status pending.

how.state: SELECT start_date, end_date, days FROM requests WHERE id = <id> → 2030-03-15, 2030-03-13, -1

hint: In createRequest, refuse with 400 when end < start (and when the working-day count is below 1), before the balance check and the INSERT.
